Step 3:  We can then simplify this expression by dividing both sides by $x^{20}$, resulting in $x^{\log_{2026}x-20}=26^{20}$.

Step 8:  Substituting back $y=\frac{\log 26}{\log x}$, we get $\frac{\log 26}{\log x}\log x=20\log 26$, which simplifies to $\log 26=20\log 26$.
